name: ecofutures-simulator

scripts.build: npm run abis && tsc --noEmit && vite build
scripts.app: npm run abis && vite build && electron .
scripts.dist:mac: npm run abis && vite build && node scripts/fetch-anvil.mjs mac-arm64 mac-x64 && electron-builder --mac --arm64 --x64
scripts.dist:win: npm run abis && vite build && node scripts/fetch-anvil.mjs win-x64 && electron-builder --win --x64
scripts.dist:linux: npm run abis && vite build && node scripts/fetch-anvil.mjs linux-x64 linux-arm64 && electron-builder --linux --x64 --arm64

description: EcoFutures V11 on a local chain: configurable scenarios run on the real contracts.

linux.synopsis: EcoFutures V11 on a local chain
